columns.polar_template|chassisandvehicle|chassis: Unique integer identifier for chassis registry entry. Numeric values, roughly 1 to 999.
Eight-character identifier: letters 'PE' followed by six digits, e.g. PE100139. Unique per record.
Integer reference ID for chassis transaction. Numeric values, roughly 1 to 1000.
columns.polar_template|chassisandvehicle|brakepa: Brake pad wear expressed as percentage. Numeric values from 0.1 to 99.9, mostly one decimal.
columns.polar_template|chassisandvehicle|brakefl: Brake fluid level expressed as percentage. Numeric values from 0.03 to 99.78, up to two decimals.
columns.polar_template|chassisandvehicle|brakepr: Brake pressure measurement, integer kilopascals. Common values roughly 1500 to 3000.
columns.polar_template|chassisandvehicle|trackte: Track tension value in kilonewtons. Numeric real, values from about 0.2 to 46.5.
columns.polar_template|chassisandvehicle|trackwe: Track wear expressed as percentage. Numeric values from 0.01 to 99.76, typically two decimals.
columns.polar_template|chassisandvehicle|suspens: Suspension height measurement in millimeters. Numeric real, values from 0.0 to 999.4.
columns.polar_template|chassisandvehicle|vehicle: Vehicle speed in km/h. Numeric real, values from near 0 to about 118.
Vehicle load mass in kilograms. Numeric real, values from about 985 to 4997.
Vehicle angle measurement in degrees. Numeric real, values roughly 0 to 177.
Compass heading in degrees. Numeric real, values from 0.0 to 354.0.
columns.polar_template|chassisandvehicle|chassis: Integer engine reference ID for chassis. Numeric values from 1 to 1000.
columns.polar_template|chassisandvehicle|tiremet: Stores JSON object containing three tire fields: pressure_kpa, temperature_c, and tread_depth_mm.
Tire pressure, integer kPa, values 50 to 300. Field inside tiremetrics JSON object.
Tire temperature in degrees Celsius, real, values -19.87 to 99.98. Field inside tiremetrics JSON object.
Tire tread depth in millimeters, real with two decimals, values 0.0 to 9.98. Field inside tiremetrics JSON object.
columns.polar_template|operationmaintenance|opma: Integer ID from 1 to 1000. One row per maintenance record. Primary key for operationmaintenance table. No nulls.
Text formatted as PE plus six digits, e.g., PE100139. Exactly 8 characters. Unique per record. Identifies associated equipment.
Integer ID from 1 to 1000. Unique in column. Links to location registry. Identifies where operation or maintenance occurs.
columns.polar_template|operationmaintenance|oper: Numeric real value with one decimal. Values roughly from 32.0 to 44286.0. Tracks accumulated operation time.
columns.polar_template|operationmaintenance|main: Numeric real value with one decimal. Values roughly from 986.0 to 4948.0. Defines interval between maintenance cycles.
columns.polar_template|operationmaintenance|last: ISO format YYYY-MM-DD. Dates from 2024-02-20 to 2025-02-19. Many repeated dates. No nulls.
columns.polar_template|operationmaintenance|next: ISO format YYYY-MM-DD. Dates from 2025-02-20 to 2026-02-19. Often one year after last maintenance. No nulls.
columns.polar_template|operationmaintenance|oper: One of Active, Standby, Maintenance, Repair, Storage. No nulls. Distribution roughly equal, around 180 to 220 per category.
columns.polar_template|operationmaintenance|crew: One of Valid, Pending, Expired. No nulls. Expired is most common.
columns.polar_template|operationmaintenance|insp: One of Passed, Pending, Failed. No nulls. Three states roughly equal.
columns.polar_template|operationmaintenance|comp: One of Compliant, Non-compliant, Review. No nulls. Values 6 to 13 characters long.
columns.polar_template|operationmaintenance|docu: One of Complete, Incomplete, Updated. No nulls. Updated and Complete are common.
columns.polar_template|operationmaintenance|opma: Integer ID from 1 to 1000. Unique per record. Links to communication registry. No nulls.
columns.polar_template|operationmaintenance|cost: Text JSON containing repair_usd, operating_usd, maintenance_usd numeric amounts. One unique object per record. Length 75 to 79 characters.
Numeric value inside costmetrics JSON. Ranges from about 4.18 to 4989.14. Values have up to two decimals. Stored as JSON number.
Numeric value inside costmetrics JSON. Ranges from about 1.15 to 999.3. Values have one to two decimals. Stored as JSON number.
Numeric value inside costmetrics JSON. Ranges from about 11.5 to 9983.37. Values have one to two decimals. Stored as JSON number.
columns.polar_template|thermalsolarwindandgrid|t: Unique integer, 1-1000, one per record. Probably sequential ID.
8 chars, 'PE' plus 6 digits. Unique per record.
Unique integer, 1-1000, links communication record. Probably sequential.
Three categories, approx equal counts. All 6-8 letter words.
columns.polar_template|thermalsolarwindandgrid|i: Categorical, exactly 4 chars, equal distribution. Counts 356/300/344.
columns.polar_template|thermalsolarwindandgrid|h: Real number, 0.2-500 kWh, many decimals. Varies widely.
columns.polar_template|thermalsolarwindandgrid|s: Three categories, counts similar. Lengths 5-8, counts 331/319/350.
columns.polar_template|thermalsolarwindandgrid|w: Three categories, counts similar. Lengths 5-9, counts 337/323/340.
columns.polar_template|thermalsolarwindandgrid|p: Three values, one has space. Counts equal, 330/336/334.
Real number, 0.07-99.91, two decimals. Many distinct values, 955 in 1000 rows.
columns.polar_template|thermalsolarwindandgrid|f: Numeric, 0-3000 W, decimals. Despite integer type, values like 1758.68.
Real 0-100, one decimal. Many distinct values, 622 in 1000 rows.
columns.polar_template|thermalsolarwindandgrid|h: Real 0.12-99.98, two decimals. Many distinct values, 948 in 1000.
columns.polar_template|thermalsolarwindandgrid|o: Real 0.03-99.78, two decimals. Many distinct values, 952 in 1000.
columns.polar_template|thermalsolarwindandgrid|t: Unique integer, 1-1000, per record. Probably sequential ID.
columns.polar_template|thermalsolarwindandgrid|r: Nested JSON: wind rpm/output_w, solar output_w/temp/efficiency. Length ~121-129 chars.
Integer, 2-2999, extracted from renewablemetrics JSON. 839 distinct values.
Real, 0.26-2997.76, decimals, from JSON. 999 distinct values.
Real, 0.8-1999.34, decimals, from JSON. 997 distinct values.
Real, -9.81 to 99.75, decimals, from JSON. 960 distinct values.
Real, 0.02-100.0, decimals, from JSON. 951 distinct values.
columns.polar_template|scientific|sciregistry: Integer from 1 to 999. Unique per record, no nulls. Sequential registry identifier.
columns.polar_template|scientific|scieqref: 8-character code, format PE######, e.g., PE100139. Unique per record, no nulls. Identifies equipment.
columns.polar_template|scientific|scientificequi: One of three states: Operating, Standby, Fault. No nulls. Indicates equipment condition.
columns.polar_template|scientific|dataloggingsta: One of Active, Paused, or Error. No nulls. Shows whether data capture running, halted, or failed.
columns.polar_template|scientific|sensorstatus: One of Normal, Warning, Error. No nulls. Reflects sensor condition.
columns.polar_template|scientific|calibrationsta: One of Valid, Due, Expired. No nulls. Tracks calibration state.
columns.polar_template|scientific|measurementacc: Numeric value with decimals, range 0.02 to 99.97 percent. No nulls. Higher means more accurate.
columns.polar_template|transmission|transregistr: Unique integer, 1-999, sequential registry record ID.
columns.polar_template|transmission|transeqref: Unique code, 8 characters, pattern 'PE' + six digits, e.g., PE100139.
columns.polar_template|transmission|transengflui: Unique integer, roughly 1-1000, references engine fluids record.
columns.polar_template|transmission|transmission: Numeric temperature with decimals, approximate range -0.1 to 148 C.
Numeric pressure with decimals, approximate range 993 to 2000 kPa.
Integer gear number, from 1 to 10, current gear.
columns.polar_template|transmission|differential: Numeric temperature with decimals, approximate range 0.1 to 113.5 C.
columns.polar_template|transmission|axletemperat: Numeric temperature with decimals, approximate range 0.17 to 118.1 C.
columns.polar_template|transmission|transopmaint: Unique integer, roughly 1-1000, references operation/maintenance record.
columns.polar_template|equipment|equipmentcode: Unique code like PE100139. Format AA followed by 6 digits. Identifier for equipment.
columns.polar_template|equipment|equipmenttype: One of six types: Shelter, Scientific, Vehicle, Safety, Communication, Generator.
columns.polar_template|equipment|equipmentmodel: Model name format 'Model-###' with three-digit number, e.g. Model-983.
columns.polar_template|equipment|manufacturer: Company that made equipment. Various formats like 'Martin Ltd', 'Johnson-Rodriguez', 'Abbott Inc'.
columns.polar_template|equipment|servicelifeyear: Integer number of years equipment expected to last.
columns.polar_template|equipment|equipmentutiliz: Percent of time equipment used, value 0.0 to 99.0.
columns.polar_template|equipment|efficiencyindex: Efficiency index, real number 0.1 to 99.9, though column type listed as integer.
columns.polar_template|equipment|environmentalim: Environmental impact index, real number 0.2 to 99.8, though column type listed as integer.
columns.polar_template|powerbattery|powerbattreg: Integer ID for battery registry record. Range 1-999, one per row.
columns.polar_template|powerbattery|pwrbatteqref: Equipment reference code. Format PE plus six digits, e.g., PE100139. Unique per battery.
columns.polar_template|powerbattery|powerstatus: Status text: Charging, On, Off, Sleep. One of four values.
columns.polar_template|powerbattery|powersource: Source of power: Solar, Battery, Diesel, Wind, Hybrid. One of five values.
columns.polar_template|powerbattery|chargingstat: Charging status: Charging, Not Charging, Full, Error. One of four values.
columns.polar_template|powerbattery|powerconsump: Real number, watts consumed. Values vary, typically with one decimal, e.g., 4643.0.
columns.polar_template|powerbattery|batterystatu: JSON object with cycles, current_a, voltage_v, level_percent, temperature_c, health_percent. Contains all battery measurements.
Integer cycle count inside batterystatus JSON. Range 1-999, many repeated values.
Current measurement in amperes, decimal like 44.15. Range about 0.05 to 49.99.
Voltage measurement in volts, decimal like 15.7. Range 0.0 to 48.0.
Charge level percentage, decimal like 42.0. Range 0.0 to 100.0.
Temperature in degrees Celsius, decimal like -34.3. Range -39.9 to 39.9.
Health percentage, decimal like 71.0. Range 60.0 to 100.0.
columns.polar_template|weatherandstructure|weath: Unique integer ID for each weather registry entry. Values range 1-1000, no nulls. Used as table key.
Integer ID linking weather record to location. Unique values 1-1000, no nulls. One per record.
columns.polar_template|weatherandstructure|exter: External temperature in degrees Celsius. Decimal values from negative to about 47. Format one/two digits plus decimals.
columns.polar_template|weatherandstructure|winds: Wind speed in m/s. Decimal values up to about 60. Format one/two digits plus decimals.
columns.polar_template|weatherandstructure|windd: Wind direction angle in degrees, 0-360. Decimal values, e.g., 1.0 to 359.7. Format one to three digits plus decimal.
columns.polar_template|weatherandstructure|barom: Atmospheric pressure in hPa. Decimal values roughly 913 to 1084. Format three/four digits plus decimals.
columns.polar_template|weatherandstructure|solar: Solar radiation flux in W/m². Decimal values up to about 1496.6. Format three/four digits plus decimals.
columns.polar_template|weatherandstructure|snowd: Snow depth in cm. Whole numbers, non-negative, values up to 999. Format one to three digits.
columns.polar_template|weatherandstructure|iceth: Ice thickness in cm. Decimal values, 0.02 to 99.94. Format one/two digits plus decimals.
columns.polar_template|weatherandstructure|visib: Visibility distance in km. Decimal values, 0.04 to 49.94. Format one/two digits plus decimals.
columns.polar_template|weatherandstructure|preci: Categorical text values: None, Ice, Snow, Blowing Snow. Length 3-12 characters.
Precipitation fall rate in mm/h. Decimal values, 0.089 to 99.614. Format one/two digits plus decimals.
columns.polar_template|weatherandstructure|snowl: Snow load in kg/m². Whole numbers, non-negative, values up to 998. Format one to three digits.
columns.polar_template|weatherandstructure|struc: Structural load in percent. Decimal values, 0.07 to 99.96. Format one/two digits plus decimals.
Status category values: Normal, Warning, Critical. Length 6-8 characters.
columns.polar_template|weatherandstructure|vibra: Vibration magnitude in millimeters per second squared. Decimal values, 0 to 49.9. Format one/two digits plus decimals.
columns.polar_template|weatherandstructure|noise: Sound level in dB. Decimal values, 0.07 to 144.56. Format one/two/three digits plus decimals.
columns.polar_template|weatherandstructure|weath: Integer ID linking weather record to operations/maintenance record. Unique values 1-1000, no nulls.
columns.polar_template|location|locationregistry: Integer values, roughly 1 to 999. Each record has own number; looks numeric, length 1-4.
columns.polar_template|location|loceqref: Text code always 8 characters, pattern AADDDDDD. Example PE100139, PE999844. Every row has distinct value.
columns.polar_template|location|Timestamp: Text datetime in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.ffffff format, 24-26 characters. Fractional part has 4 to 6 digits. Values range from 2024-02-19 to 2025-02-18.
columns.polar_template|location|stationname: Format Station-N, where N appears to be 1 to 20. Length 9 or 10 characters. Examples Station-1, Station-9, Station-18.
columns.polar_template|location|locationtype: Text column with only two values: Arctic (512 rows) and Antarctic (488 rows). Length 6 to 9 characters.
columns.polar_template|location|latitude: Real number, decimal degrees. Negative values are south; positive are north. Observed range about -60.0 to +89.97. Patterns like DD.DDDDDD or -DD.DDDDDD.
columns.polar_template|location|longitude: Real number, decimal degrees. Values mostly positive, some small negative. Patterns include DD.DDDDDD and DDD.DDDDDD, with optional minus sign.
columns.polar_template|location|altitudem: Real number expressing elevation, likely meters. Values range from 10.5 to 999.9. Length 3 to 6 characters, patterns like DDDD.D or DD.D.
columns.polar_template|lightingandsafety|lightre: Registry identifier for light fixtures. Unique integer values from 1 to 999, no nulls. Used as record key.
columns.polar_template|lightingandsafety|lighteq: Equipment reference for light, always 8 chars: 'PE' plus six digits. Unique values range from PE100139 to PE999844.
columns.polar_template|lightingandsafety|lightin: Lighting control state, three values: 'Auto', 'On', 'Off'. No nulls; roughly equal distribution.
Lighting intensity as percentage, approximate range 0.2–99.77. Real values with 1–2 decimal places; many distinct values.
columns.polar_template|lightingandsafety|externa: Status of external lights, three values: 'On', 'Auto', 'Off'. Equal distribution, no nulls.
columns.polar_template|lightingandsafety|emergen: Status of emergency lighting, three values: 'On', 'Off', 'Testing'. No nulls, roughly equal counts.
Emergency stop safety state, values 'Ready', 'Reset', 'Activated'. Each appears about one-third of records.
columns.polar_template|lightingandsafety|alarmst: Alarm system status with values 'Critical', 'Normal', 'Warning'. Distribution roughly equal, no nulls.
columns.polar_template|lightingandsafety|safetys: Overall safety system state, values 'Active', 'Standby', 'Fault'. No nulls, roughly equal counts.
columns.polar_template|lightingandsafety|lifesup: Life support system condition, values 'Critical', 'Normal', 'Warning'. Roughly equal counts, no nulls.
columns.polar_template|lightingandsafety|oxygens: Oxygen supply condition, values 'Critical', 'Normal', 'Warning'. No nulls; similar distribution.
columns.polar_template|lightingandsafety|medical: Medical equipment condition, values 'Normal', 'Critical', 'Warning'. Roughly equal distribution, no nulls.
columns.polar_template|lightingandsafety|wastema: Waste management system condition, values 'Warning', 'Critical', 'Normal'. Roughly equal counts, no nulls.
columns.polar_template|lightingandsafety|watersu: Water supply system condition, values 'Warning', 'Critical', 'Normal'. No nulls, similar distribution.
columns.polar_template|lightingandsafety|safetys: Contains nested fields co_detection, gas_detection, fire_detection, smoke_detection. Each field value is 'Normal', 'Alert', or 'Fault'. 81 distinct combinations.
Carbon monoxide sensor state in safetysensors JSON. Values: 'Alert', 'Fault', 'Normal'; no nulls.
Gas sensor state in safetysensors JSON. Values: 'Fault', 'Normal', 'Alert'; 'Fault' most common.
Fire sensor state in safetysensors JSON. Values: 'Normal', 'Fault', 'Alert'; 'Normal' most common.
Smoke sensor state in safetysensors JSON. Values: 'Normal', 'Fault', 'Alert'; no nulls.
columns.polar_template|communication|commregistr: Integer from 1 to 999. Unique value in each record. Looks like sequential registry number.
columns.polar_template|communication|commeqref: Text code form PE plus 6 digits, always 8 characters. Unique per record, range PE100139 to PE999844.
columns.polar_template|communication|commlocref: Integer ranges from 1 to 1000. Unique per record.
columns.polar_template|communication|radiofreque: Numeric frequency from 100.4 to 899.9 MHz. Values shown as integer or one-decimal number.
columns.polar_template|communication|antennastat: One of Normal, Error, or Warning. Each value appears in hundreds of records.
columns.polar_template|communication|bluetoothst: One of Error, Off, On, or Pairing. Counts are roughly similar.
columns.polar_template|communication|commopmaint: Column has no non-null values across all 1000 records. Declared integer type.
columns.polar_template|communication|signalmetri: Stores latency, GPS strength, data rate, satellite status, Wi-Fi strength, and radio strength. Unique JSON string per record, length 157 to 170 characters.
Number from 100.6 to 1999.0 ms. Usually one decimal place.
One of Strong, Weak, Medium, or None. Strong, Weak, Medium each appear about 300 times; None rare.
Number from 1.8 to 999.5 kbps. Values are integer or one decimal.
One of Limited, Disconnected, or Connected. Counts roughly equal, around 316 to 347.
Negative number from -89.8 to -30.1 dBm. Values integer or one decimal.
Negative number from -119.7 to -60.0 dBm. Values usually one decimal.
columns.polar_template|engineandfluids|enginereg: Whole-number identifier, no nulls, unique across rows. Values look like 1 to 1000; pattern D to DDDD.
columns.polar_template|engineandfluids|engfluids: Text string exactly 8 characters long; pattern PE + 6 digits (AADDDDDD). Unique per row; no nulls.
Whole-number reference value. Values range from 1 to 1000, no nulls, all distinct. Pattern D to DDDD.
columns.polar_template|engineandfluids|enginespe: Whole-number rpm values, 1 to 4 digits. Common values around 3000, 5000, and 7000; 938 distinct values; repeats occur.
columns.polar_template|engineandfluids|engineloa: Numeric load percentage with one or two decimals. Values range from 0.1 to 99.95; 950 distinct values; repeated values common.
columns.polar_template|engineandfluids|enginetem: Numeric temperature with one or two decimals; may include negative values. Observed values roughly -0.6 to 148+; 970 distinct values.
columns.polar_template|engineandfluids|enginehou: Numeric runtime with one decimal. Values mostly from about 995 to 4558; 989 distinct values; repeated values exist.
columns.polar_template|engineandfluids|engfluids: Whole-number reference value. Values range from 1 to 1000, no nulls, all distinct. Pattern D to DDDD.
columns.polar_template|engineandfluids|fluidmetr: Text JSON with four groups: oil, fuel, coolant, hydraulic. Each group contains pressure_kpa, level_percent, temperature_c; fuel also has consumption_lh. Values are numbers; text length 342-355 chars.
Numeric pressure value in kilopascals. Values are whole numbers, 3-4 digits, range 106 to 4990; 899 distinct values.
Numeric percentage with one or two decimals. Values range 0.05 to 99.95; 962 distinct values.
Numeric temperature with one or two decimals. Values range 0.05 to 119.9; 955 distinct values.
Numeric pressure value in kilopascals. Values are whole numbers, 2-4 digits, range 12 to 1000; 634 distinct values.
Numeric fuel level percentage as whole numbers. Values range 0 to 100 inclusive; 101 distinct values; many repeats.
Numeric temperature with one or two decimals and possible negative sign. Values range -19.83 to 59.97; 941 distinct values.
Numeric consumption rate in liters per hour. Values have one or two decimals, range 0.01 to 49.96; 905 distinct values.
Numeric pressure value in kilopascals. Values are whole numbers, 3-4 digits, range 100 to 1999; 787 distinct values.
Numeric percentage with one or two decimals. Values range 0.02 to 99.82; 950 distinct values.
Numeric temperature with one or two decimals and possible negative sign. Values range -9.7 to 119.59; 961 distinct values.
Numeric pressure value in kilopascals with up to three decimals. Values range 1.015 to 1995.653; 1000 distinct values in 1000 rows.
Numeric percentage with one or two decimals. Values range 0.04 to 99.96; 955 distinct values.
Numeric temperature with one or two decimals and possible negative sign. Values range -9.9 to 119.98; 958 distinct values.
columns.polar_template|waterandwaste|waterregist: Integer, no nulls. 1000 distinct values among 1000 rows. Observed min 1, max 999. Digit strings length 1 to 4.
columns.polar_template|waterandwaste|watereqref: Text, always 8 characters. Pattern AADDDDDD: two letters 'PE' followed by six digits. Unique values, sampled range PE100139 to PE999844.
columns.polar_template|waterandwaste|waterlevelp: Numeric percent. Values 0.24 to 99.99. Decimals with one or two digits, some integers. Duplicate values present.
columns.polar_template|waterandwaste|waterpressu: Real number in kPa. Values 0.7 to 998.97. Mostly unique; decimal values with one or two decimal digits.
columns.polar_template|waterandwaste|watertemper: Numeric Celsius. Values -0.12 to 99.96. One or two decimal digits; occasional negative values. Some duplicates.
columns.polar_template|waterandwaste|waterflowlp: Real number in L/min. Values 0.785 to 998.889. Mostly three decimal digits; all 1000 values unique.
columns.polar_template|waterandwaste|waterqualit: Integer index. Values 1 to 999. One to four digit numbers; duplicates present. Common values include 451, 883, 219, 2.
columns.polar_template|waterandwaste|wastetankle: Numeric percent. Values 0.14 to 99.95. Decimals with one or two digits; duplicate values present.
columns.polar_template|cabinenvironment|cabinreg: Integer ID, unique per record. Values range 1 to 1000. No nulls. Identifies cabin environment record.
columns.polar_template|cabinenvironment|cabineqr: Text code, always 8 characters, format 'PE' plus 6 digits. Unique per record. References cabin equipment.
columns.polar_template|cabinenvironment|cabinloc: Integer ID, unique per record. Values range 1 to 1000. No nulls. References cabin location.
columns.polar_template|cabinenvironment|emergenc: Text status, 3 values: Active, Standby, Testing. Length 6 or 7. No nulls. Describes emergency beacon mode.
columns.polar_template|cabinenvironment|ventilat: Text status, 3 values: Auto, On, Off. Length 2 to 4. No nulls. Describes ventilation system mode.
Numeric percentage, approx 0.21 to 99.89. Decimal format usually DD.DD. No nulls. Describes fan speed.
columns.polar_template|cabinenvironment|heaterst: Text status, 3 values: Auto, On, Off. Length 2 to 4. No nulls. Describes heater system mode.
columns.polar_template|cabinenvironment|heaterte: Numeric temperature value, decimal format usually DD.DD. No nulls. Represents heater temperature in degrees Celsius.
columns.polar_template|cabinenvironment|defroste: Text status, 3 values: Auto, On, Off. Length 2 to 4. No nulls. Describes defroster system mode.
columns.polar_template|cabinenvironment|windowst: Text status, 3 values: Open, Closed, Partial. Length 4 to 7. No nulls. Describes window opening state.
columns.polar_template|cabinenvironment|doorstat: Text status, 3 values: Open, Closed, Locked. Length 4 to 6. No nulls. Describes door operation state.
columns.polar_template|cabinenvironment|hatchsta: Text status, 3 values: Open, Closed, Locked. Length 4 to 6. No nulls. Describes hatch operation state.
columns.polar_template|cabinenvironment|cabincom: Integer ID, unique per record. Values range 1 to 1000. No nulls. References cabin communication entry.
columns.polar_template|cabinenvironment|cabincli: Text JSON object containing six numeric fields: co2_ppm, o2_percent, pressure_kpa, temperature_c, humidity_percent, air_quality_index. One unique JSON string per record. Contains cabin air sensor readings.
Field inside cabinclimate JSON. Numeric ppm value, range approx 8.7 to 4991.1, decimal format. No nulls. Represents carbon dioxide level.
Field inside cabinclimate JSON. Numeric percentage, range approx 10.01 to 21.0, format DD.DD. No nulls. Represents oxygen level.
Field inside cabinclimate JSON. Numeric kPa value, range 801 to 1200, integer format. No nulls. Represents cabin air pressure.
Field inside cabinclimate JSON. Numeric degrees Celsius, range -29.89 to 39.9, can be negative, decimal format. No nulls. Represents cabin air temperature.
Field inside cabinclimate JSON. Numeric percentage, range 0.1 to 99.8, decimal format. No nulls. Represents relative humidity.
Field inside cabinclimate JSON. Numeric index, range 0.03 to 499.54, decimal format. No nulls. Represents overall air quality.
